name: Hysilens
description:
Styxia, the coastal city of intoxication and dreams, where echoes of old songs still drift among the waves.
Helektra, Daughter of the Sea, Chrysos Heir who cleanses the Ocean's Coreflame, dispels the murky undercurrents and orchestrates a banquet of revelry for the heroes beyond the sky.
The show must go on. Even if hope is as fragile as bubbles, the waves will keep surging forward.

skills.name: Aeolian Mode: Echoes in Still Waters
skills.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Hysilens's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDesc: Deals minor Physical DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Overtone Hum: Chorus After Dark Tides
skills.desc: Has a #2[i]% base chance to increase the DMG taken by all enemies by #3[i]%, lasting for #4[i] turn(s). At the same time, deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Hysilens's ATK to all enemies.
skills.simpleDesc: There is a high chance to increase the DMG taken by all enemies, and deals Physical DMG to them.

extra.name: Base Chance
extra.desc:
The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit.
The final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Maelstrom Rhapsody
skills.desc:
Hysilens deploys a Zone that reduces enemy targets' ATK by #6[f1]% and DEF by #3[f1]%, and deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Hysilens's ATK to all enemies.
For every 1 instance of DoT taken by an enemy target within the Zone, Hysilens deals Physical DoT equal to #4[f1]% of her ATK to them. This damage triggers at the start of each turn or after one attack by an ally target, up to #5[i] time(s). And it cannot repeatedly trigger this effect.
The Zone lasts for #2[i] turn(s) and this duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's every turn. When Hysilens gets knocked down, the Zone will also be dispelled.
skills.simpleDesc: Deploys a Zone that reduces all enemies' ATK and DEF, and deals Physical DMG to them. While the Zone exists, for every 1 instance of DoT received by enemy targets, deals 1 instance of Physical DoT to them.

extra.name: Downed State
extra.desc: An ally will be incapacitated once their HP is reduced to 0.

skills.name: Sirenic Serenade
skills.desc:
When an ally target attacks, there is a #1[i]% base chance for Hysilens to inflict the hit enemy target with one of the following states: Wind Shear, Bleed, Burn, or Shock. Priority is given to inflicting a different state.
While in the Wind Shear/Burn/Shock state, at the start of each turn, the enemy target takes Wind/Fire/Lightning DoT equal to #2[f1]% of Hysilens's ATK for #5[i] turn(s).
While in the Bleed state, at the start of each turn, the enemy target takes Physical DoT equal to #3[f1]% of their Max HP, up to #4[f1]% of Hysilens's ATK, lasting for #5[i] turn(s).
skills.simpleDesc: When an ally target attacks, Hysilens has a high chance to inflict the hit enemy target with one of the following states: Wind Shear/Bleed/Burn/Shock.

extra.name: Base Chance
extra.desc:
The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit.
The final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: At Ocean's Abode
skills.desc:
After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for #1[i] seconds and automatically moves forward. Enemies within the Special Dimension enter the "Soulstruck" state. "Soulstruck" enemies will not attack ally targets and will follow the dimension while it persists.
After entering combat with "Soulstruck" enemies, there is a #2[i]% base chance to inflict each enemy target with #3[i] of the following states: Wind Shear/Bleed/Burn/Shock, all of which are equivalent to those provided by Hysilens's Talent effect. Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.
skills.simpleDesc: Creates a Special Dimension. Enemies within the dimension will not attack ally targets. After entering combat with enemies within the dimension, there's a high chance to inflict #3[i] state(s) from Wind Shear/Bleed/Burn/Shock on each enemy target.

extra.name: Base Chance
extra.desc:
The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit.
The final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

eidolons.name: You Ask Why Hearts Cry
eidolons.desc: While Hysilens is on the field, the DoT dealt by ally targets is equal to 116% of their original value. When Hysilens inflicts Wind Shear/Bleed/Burn/Shock on enemies via her Talent, there is a 100% <u>base chance</u> to additionally inflict the target with 1 instance of Wind Shear/Bleed/Burn/Shock state that is equivalent to those from the original Talent effect and can coexist with such pre-existing states.

extra.name: Base Chance
extra.desc:
The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit.
The final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

eidolons.name: Tell Me Why Waves Roar High
eidolons.desc: While the Zone is active, the DMG Boost effect from Trace "<link kind="trace" to="the_fiddle_of_pearls">The Fiddle of Pearls</link>" applies to all allies.

eidolons.name: Why Do Lights Bid Goodbye
eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Lo, How Time Flows By
eidolons.desc: While the Zone is active, reduces All-Type RES of all enemies by 20%.

eidolons.name: In Ablution, I Hum and Sigh
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: When to Return From Where You Lie
eidolons.desc: While the Zone is active, at the start of each turn or after one attack by an ally target, increases the maximum trigger count for Hysilens's Physical DoT effect to 12, and increases the multiplier of the DMG dealt by 20%.

embedBonusSkill.name: The Gladius of Conquest
embedBonusSkill.desc: At the start of combat, Hysilens deploys a Zone, equivalent to that provided by her Ultimate, lasting for 3 turn(s). Whenever Hysilens deploys a Zone, she recovers 1 Skill Point(s).

embedBonusSkill.name: The Bubble of Banquets
embedBonusSkill.desc: When Hysilens uses Ultimate, if the enemy target is currently afflicted with DoT(s), all DoTs currently applied on the target will immediately produce DMG equal to 150% of their original DMG.

embedBonusSkill.name: The Fiddle of Pearls
embedBonusSkill.desc: For every 10% of Hysilens's Effect Hit Rate that exceeds 60%, increases her DMG dealt by 15%, up to a max increase of 90%.
